title.narrative: Department of Energy, Nuclear Smuggling Detection and Deterrence Program

description.narrative: The Department of Energy National Nuclear Security Administration (DOE/NNSA) Office of Nuclear Smuggling Detection and Deterrence (NSDD) works with international partners to strengthen capabilities to deter, detect, and investigate the smuggling of nuclear and radiological materials by providing the expertise and tools needed to respond to smuggling events.
